final_assessment: Proposed change-account from its exploration (consume mode): the first of stage program-brief's three changes. A fourth record, the account (built, seams, deviations), written by the apply session that checks the last task and replaced by a later apply or the walk, with its own write gate (one chain per change, active change only), kept in .orbit-runs/account/ so no reader takes it yet. Two capabilities, four requirements (three ADDED, one MODIFIED), eleven tasks; no size breach. D-ca-1 and D-ca-2 carried as normative tables. Design departs from D-ca-2's imagined filter: a separate folder holds the same rule by construction.
